{{Top|leg}}
An '''atmosphere sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could analyze the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and determine the class type&mdash;Type I, II, III, or IV&mdash;within a half [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. [[9G Explorer Droid]]s were fitted with atmosphere sensors.
